digest.component_or_area: container plan-review attestation drift-scope inheritance and P9 gate
propositions: A live declared-none child must be neutral in container inheritance, contributing no paths and not poisoning sibling path declarations.
The current binary rule wrongly treats every empty-path-list child as undeclared, forcing whole-HEAD invalidation.
all_none is true only when at least one live child exists and every live child is authenticated none; no live children yields false.

Scope precedence resolves to paths for any own/cited/inherited path, else explicit parent none, else promotes only undeclared parents when all live children are none, else unscoped; a parent declared paths is never promoted to none.
Any live undeclared child poisons child inheritance so no child paths are inherited and the container is not classified all-none.
P9 passes declared-none leaves and all-declared containers, and advises only live undeclared poisoners naming both path declaration and --none remedies.
